triage.fix_rationale: The TypeScript 7 bump conflicts with the Angular toolchain's peer range. Ignoring TypeScript major bumps in dependabot.yml, or grouping them with the Angular upgrades, stops the failing update. package.json and package-lock.json hold the pins.
triage.hypothesis: Dependabot tried to bump typescript to 7.0.2, but npm peer resolution fails because @angular/build@22.0.5 requires typescript ">=6.0 <6.1" while the tree has typescript@6.0.3. Both the plain and the --force npm installs hit ERESOLVE, and the forced one ran about 2500s and exited 134, so the updater failed.
